column1: # Romanian words with their diacritics stripped, as someone types them on a layout
# that has none -- and the spelling the keyboard must restore. Fed to
# `suggest_eval --autocorrect`, which asks what the space bar commits.
# Generated by tools/make_accent_corpus.py, stratified across six frequency bands so
# the rare half is represented. That stratification is the point: restoration used to
# work for common words and fail for rare ones, so a corpus drawn from the top of the
# word list reported near-perfect while 'cana' was being committed as 'canal'.
